summary: Russia launched a massive overnight drone and missile attack targeting multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Odesa, Vinnytsia, Kharkiv, and Kirovohrad oblasts, with cruise missiles launched from the Black Sea toward Odesa. Kyiv experienced direct hits, including a 6-story residential building in the Shevchenkivskyi district and a FedEx warehouse in the Holosiivskyi district. Separately, an armed clash between SBU and GUR officers in Kyiv resulted in one GUR officer killed and two wounded, highlighting internal Ukrainian security service tensions.
key_points: A 6-story residential building in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district was struck by a drone, causing a fire according to Klitschko. (Source: @UkraineNow/83836)
Russia launched cruise missiles from the Black Sea toward Odesa and Chornomorsk, alongside widespread Shahed drone strikes across multiple oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73327)
A Russian drone struck a FedEx warehouse in Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district, according to leaked channel reporting. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32946)
One GUR officer was killed and two wounded during a shootout with SBU special forces in Kyiv, with media citing disputes over a fraudulent call center. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32940)
Moscow's air defense intercepted 109 Ukrainian UAVs over Belgorod, Bryansk, Voronezh, Kaluga, Kursk, Oryol, Moscow region, Crimea, and Black Sea per Russian summary. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)
Russian assault groups advanced on 19 sections near Kiyanitsa and Khoteni in Sumy direction with up to 800 meters advance in 24 hours per Russian report. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32934)
Russia reported shooting down 10 drones approaching Moscow, with air restrictions imposed at Vnukovo and Domodedovo airports per Sobyanin. (Source: @tass_agency/393360)
SBU and GUR jointly thwarted an assassination attempt on a Russian opposition leader visiting Ukraine for Independence Day per Ukrainian officials. (Source: @UkraineNow/83832)

sections.executive_summary: Russia executed a large-scale overnight aerial assault on multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Odesa, Vinnytsia, Kharkiv, Kirovohrad, and Poltava oblasts, combining Shahed drones and cruise missiles launched from the Black Sea. Kyiv sustained significant impacts, including a 6-story residential building fire in the Shevchenkivskyi district and a strike on a FedEx warehouse. A deadly armed confrontation between SBU and GUR officers in Kyiv, resulting in one GUR fatality, underscored serious internal security service conflicts amid the ongoing war.

sections.threat_assessment: The conflict situation has escalated significantly with Russia executing sustained mass aerial operations across Ukrainian territory for the seventh consecutive day, combining Shahed drones and cruise missiles to overwhelm Ukrainian air defense. The geographic spread of strikes targeting Kyiv, Odesa, Kharkiv, Vinnytsia, and multiple other oblasts indicates a deliberate strategy to deplete Ukrainian interception capacity and damage critical infrastructure. The internal armed conflict between SBU and GUR in Kyiv, resulting in casualties, represents a serious security crisis that could compromise Ukrainian counterintelligence capabilities. Russian advances in the Sumy direction of up to 800 meters in 24 hours suggest continued offensive pressure in northern Ukraine, while the deployment of FABs alongside UAVs against Odesa indicates escalation in strike munitions variety.
sections.regional_response: Germany has committed to delivering new air defense packages to Ukraine this month according to Zelensky, while the US through Secretary Rubio is engaging on Patriot missile production licensing though acknowledging deployment would take years. Norway has arrested the Russian research vessel 'Professor Molchanov' as an interim measure linked to enforcement of an arbitration decision on Naftogaz assets in Crimea, demonstrating continued European legal and economic pressure on Russia. The expulsion of Russian House employees from Berlin within seven days signals escalating diplomatic measures. These actions collectively indicate Western nations are maintaining and potentially expanding support measures for Ukraine while applying diplomatic and economic pressure on Russia despite ongoing conflict intensity.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 7th consecutive day of mass drone incursions represents one of the most sustained aerial campaigns of the conflict, with cruise missile launches from the Black Sea adding a heavier strike capability. The SBU-GUR shootout appears connected to broader disputes over control of fraudulent call centers and the joint operation to protect a Russian opposition leader in Ukraine, revealing significant institutional tensions. Leaked SBU documentation highlighting shortages of air defense missiles directly correlates with the observed difficulty intercepting mass drone waves. The deployment of FAB guided bombs alongside strike drones against Odesa represents an expansion of Russian strike capabilities, while the 109 Ukrainian UAVs intercepted over Russian territory indicates Ukraine retains significant long-range strike capacity despite reported equipment shortages.
